description: Create a structured delivery plan for an initiative the user describes. Given a plain-language description of something to build, implement, modernize, migrate, or scale, this returns a plan with teams (pods), roles, AI agents, work modules sized in Delivery Units, a phased timeline, and a recommended plan size. Use this tool when a user describes a project or initiative and wants to understand the team, scope, timeline, or cost to deliver it. Returns a plan_id that the other tools use to reference this plan.

industry.description: Optional industry hint (for example FinTech, SaaS, Healthcare, Retail, Manufacturing, or Public Sector). Improves sizing accuracy.

initiative.description: A plain-language description of what the user wants to build, implement, modernize, migrate, or scale. Pass through the user's own words when possible. For example: 'Build a customer portal in 12 weeks' or 'Modernize our reporting system'.

name: create_delivery_plan

outputSchema.description: A complete Virtual Delivery Center plan: pods, roles, AI agents, modules sized in Delivery Units, phased timeline, total Delivery Units and project cost, plus the recommended Delivery Pack.

aus.description: Delivery Units for this module. JSON key is `aus` for legacy compatibility; semantically these are Delivery Units.

plan_id.description: Identifier for this plan; use it with refine_delivery_plan, get_delivery_plan, or recommend_next_step.

recommended_pack.description: The recommended Delivery Pack tier for this plan.

delivery_units.description: Delivery Units in the pack (0 for enterprise/custom).

tier_rate_per_du_usd.description: $/Delivery Unit rate for this plan size, per the tier-band rate card.

total_aus.description: Total Delivery Units across all modules. JSON key is `total_aus` for legacy compatibility.

total_cost_usd_project.description: Project-flow USD cost at the tier-band rate.

total_delivery_units.description: Public-facing alias for total_aus. Same value.
